designs.title: How Beer Is Made
designs.why: The cleanest file of the three and ready for the press. Alpha is pure 1-bit, line weight is consistent (positive strokes all hold at 0.25 mm), the bold headings and roughly 4 mm captions will hold on a 156 mesh even in white ink on black, and the flow reads clearly from 3 m. Up close there are AI artefacts: pseudo-lettering on the kettle and malting caps ('E. 3E'), wormy noise in the boiling-kettle liquid, and a few broken dashed hatch strokes on the tank cones. These are small but visible at chest distance on a $50 shirt.
designs.fix: Clean the vessel art. Delete the fake glyphs on the kettle and malting caps, replace the squiggle noise in the boil liquid with clean bubbles, and join the broken hatch dashes so the white underbase does not pick up specks.

designs.title: Gin Botanicals
designs.why: From 3 m it is an attractive, well-balanced botanical plate and the italic Latin names set nicely. At full size, though, the tone is not engraving. It is threshold and auto-trace mottle: outlined worm blobs and dots fill the juniper berries, the angelica and the orris rhizome. About 14% of the gaps are under 0.4 mm, so the shadow masses will plug and dot-gain into dark smudges. It reads as a traced photo, not a hand-cut plate, which undercuts a $50 price.
designs.fix: Rebuild the shading as real engraved line work (parallel and contour hatching with gaps of at least 0.4 mm) in place of the speckle, starting with the juniper berries and orris root, so it prints crisp and looks like a true engraving.

designs.title: Vineyard
designs.why: The composition works from a distance: farmhouse, cypresses and the sweep of the terraces, with a restrained wordmark. Close up, the foreground vines and grapes, which are meant to be the hero, are a dense tangle of broken dashes and blobs with many sub-0.4 mm gaps (about 14%) that will fill in. That makes a muddy dark lower half, and the grape bunches get lost. The ragged dotted edge at the bottom and the stray period in 'VINEYARD.' look unfinished.
designs.fix: Redraw the foreground as one clear hero grape cluster and leaves in clean engraved hatching with open gaps, and thin out the lower vine rows so the bottom of the print stays light and does not plug.
